crushRock.name: Crush broken rock
crushRock.description: Broken rock becomes an 80/20 gravel and sand blend. Screen it into clean products afterwards.

screenGravel.name: Separate gravel
screenGravel.description: Recover the gravel already in a mixed batch. Other material returns to the feed bay.

screenSand.name: Separate sand
screenSand.description: Recover the sand already in a mixed batch. Other material returns to the feed bay.

screenTopsoil.name: Recover topsoil
screenTopsoil.description: Separate the topsoil already in the feed. Every other material returns to the feed bay; no material is created.

screenClay.name: Separate clay
screenClay.description: Separate the clay already in the feed. Every other material returns to the feed bay; no material is created.
